ANSWER: 5 DGEs contribute to the Glutathione metabolism pathway enrichment in the KD condition (KL).

Contributing DGEs (primary configuration): Gclc, Gclm, Gpx4, Gpx7, Gsta4 — each is a significantly DE gene (padj<0.05, |shrunken lfc|>1, baseMean>10, all-sample baseMean, direction-agnostic) whose mapped symbol is a member of the reconstructed KEGG mmu00480 'Glutathione metabolism' gene set.

Configuration that produced 5: WL as reference (lfc = log2(KL/WL)); DESeq2-equivalent NB-GLM Wald DE; LFC shrinkage applied BEFORE the filter (shrink-then-filter) using an offline apeglm-style (heavy-tailed Cauchy-prior) approximation; filter = padj<0.05 & |shrunken lfc|>1 & baseMean>10.

Sensitivity (how the count moves under the stated ambiguities):
- Shrinkage algorithm: apeglm-approx -> 5; normal -> 3; ashr -> 3 (Gpx4 and Gsta4 drop below |lfc|>1 under the stronger normal/ashr shrinkage; Gpx4 lfc_normal=1.000 sits exactly at the boundary).
- padj vs raw p: identical (5) — all contributors have p and padj far below threshold (padj 1e-12 to 1e-203).
- MLE no-shrink lfc filter: 5 (same set).
- High-confidence-only floor (Gclc, Gclm, both high-confidence ID + unambiguous 10-40x induction): 2.
- Per-condition baseMean caveat: Gsta4's WL-condition mean is ~1.3 counts, so a per-condition baseMean>10 interpretation could exclude it.

Key assumptions affecting boundary genes: (1) all-sample DESeq2 baseMean (Gsta4 borderline if per-condition); (2) shrinkage method (Gpx4/Gsta4 flip between apeglm and normal/ashr); (3) curated Ensembl->symbol mapping confidence — Gclc/Gclm are high-confidence, Gpx4/Gpx7/Gsta4 are medium-confidence IDs (confirmed mapping errors in the memory-based table for e.g. Gsr, Gpx8, which mapped to all-zero genes — this is the largest residual uncertainty).

CRITICAL TRANSPARENCY: gseapy, R/DESeq2, and the Enrichr KEGG_2019_Mouse library could NOT be run (no internet, no R/gseapy in this sandbox — verified DNS/TCP unreachable, pip/apt fail). No gseapy call was fabricated. DE uses a documented DESeq2-equivalent (numpy/scipy), shrinkage methods are approximations, and the pathway gene set is reconstructed from KEGG mmu00480 with a confidence-tagged curated mapping. The number 5 is therefore a best-effort reconstruction, not a native gseapy/DESeq2 output.
